provenance.note: Exact pinhole observations of one rigid translating square; not measured hardware data.

settings.depthMeaning: initial center depth; use per-corner truthPoints for all projections and fits
settings.initialization: exact true instantaneous image velocity at time zero
settings.twistConvention: Pdot = v + omega cross P; camera-frame coordinates

selection.rule: Final frame at 3 seconds; no residual-based frame search.

residualDefinition: Euclidean residual of the stacked 8D estimated pixel velocity against the full current 8x6 rigid-object Jacobian, normalized by estimated flow norm.
limitations: This is a noise-free numerical example, not a measured occurrence or frequency claim.
Incompatibility is instantaneous and conditional on the current exact 3D geometry.
The physical target has fixed orientation; the fit permits all three rotations as well as translations.
The closest rigid fit is not necessarily the true motion; its residual measures compatibility, not total estimation error.
